We need to identify SMILES of an organic sample. No data given. Likely need to retrieve NMR spectra etc? But no input data provided. Perhaps the system expects us to use tools to get spectra? But we have no sample. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be that the environment has a sample loaded (the "sample at hand") for which we can request spectra. So we need to deduce structure from spectra. We need to request proton NMR, carbon NMR, maybe IR, mass spec. Then interpret to propose SMILES.

We should start by getting proton NMR.
